observations: All seven domestic direction-colored strokes and cumulative/final forms were directly compared against the complete historical GlyphWiki source u962d, using three exact records and the pinned engine.

Domestic stroke4 is one down-left then rightward movement. Source quadratic4 ends at (99.1,79), but following quadratic5 begins at (80.2,80). A continuous path would require adding a bridge or trimming/altering original points. No such reconstruction is documented.

The one-unit difference between source groups1 and2 is between separate domestic strokes1 and2, not the cause of withholding. Other directions and hooks were compared but no progressive runtime approval exists.
The exact whole glyph u9631 is present in the pinned public 2016 backup with a complete three-record dependency graph. Korean catalog: special grade, seven strokes.
The domestic SVG has been obtained in RAM and its bytes/hash recorded. Every-stroke visual comparison, progressive playback and runtime validation are still pending. There is no approval yet.
